item.title: 【Cinema Center】SERIES - 13 Cards (2024) S01 MULTi 2160p Okko WEB-DL DDP2.0 HEVC-NOOBDL [ENG/ESP/RUS]
item.description:
Synopsis:​
13 Cards follows an 18-year old named Fēdor who uses a magical deck of cards to summon eight clones to do his chores, only for the doppelgängers to develop unique, stubborn personalities and refuse to help.
Click to expand...
Available in the original Russian audio track + English, and Latin American Spanish, both subs and dubs.
Because these copies are using the original Russian localized text, I made custom forced subtitle tracks to make up for this.
Episodes 1-7 are direct WEB-DLs from Okko.tv, which has better bitrate and quality than on YouTube. Episodes 8 and 9 are YouTube WEB downloads in the VP9 codec, due to Okko only hosting unfinished versions of the episodes.
